G0100.def:
ἁδρότης, -τος, ἡ 
(ἁδρός, thick, well-grown), 
__1. thickness, vigour. 
__2. abundance, bounty: 2 Corinthiens 8:20. 
†

G0101.def:
ἀδυνατέω, -ῶ 
(ἀδύνατος), [in LXX: Deutéronome 17:8, Zacharie 8:6 (פּלא ni.), Job 42:2 (בּצר ni.), al. ;] 
__1. Abbott-Smith omits this number to be unable (cl., Philo; π., see MM, VGT, see word). 
__2. In LXX and NT (Kennedy, Sources, 124; Hatch, Essays, 4; Field, Notes, 46 f.), to be impossible: Matthieu 17:20, Luc 1:37. 
†

G0102.def:
ἀ-δύνατος, -ον, 
[in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, דַּל, etc. ;] 
__1. of persons, unable, powerless: Actes 14:8; figuratively Romains 15:1 (MM, VGT, see word). 
__2. Of things, impossible: Matthieu 19:26, Marc 10:27, Luc 18:27, Romains 8:3, Hébreux 6:4,18 10:4 11:6. 
†

G0103.def:
ᾄδω (Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω), 
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;] 
to sing, 
__(a) intrans., with dative (MM, VGT, see word), of praise to God: Éphésiens 5:19, Colossiens 3:16 ; 
__(b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν, Apocalypse 5:9 14:3 15:3. 
†

G0104.def:
ἀεί, adv., 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 42:14 (מֵעוֹלָם) 51:13 (תָּמִיד), Ps 94(95):10, al. ;] 
ever; 
__1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: Actes 7:51, 2 Co.4.11; 6:10, Tite 1:12, Hébreux 3:10.
__2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): 1 Pierre 3:15, 2 Pierre 1:12. 
†

G0105.def:
ἀετός, -οῦ, ὁ, 
[in LXX for נֶשֶׁר ;] 
an eagle: Apocalypse 4:7 8:13 (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. Job 39:30, Proverbes 30:17): Matthieu 24:28, Luc 17:37 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0106.def:
ἄζυμος, -ον 
(ζύμη), [in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה ;] 
unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., Marc 14:1), Luc 22:1; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., Matthieu 26:17, Marc 14:12, Luc 22:7; ἡμέραι, Actes 12:3 20:6. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: 1 Corinthiens 5:7; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).†

G0108.def:
Ἄζωτος, -ου, ἡ (Heb., אַשְׁדּוֹד), 
Azotus, a Philistine city: Actes 8:40.†

G0109.def:
ἀήρ, ἀέρος, ὁ, 
[in LXX: 2 Rois 22:12 (= Psa.17(18):11 שׁחק), Wi .8 ;] 
in Hom., Hes., the lower air which surrounds the earth, as opposite to the purer αἰθήρ of the higher regions; generally, air (MM, VGT, see word): Actes 22:23, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:17, Apocalypse 9:2 16:17; of the air as the realm of demons, Éphésiens 2:2; ἀ. δέρειν, of striving to no purpose, 1 Corinthiens 9:26; εἰς ἀ. λαλεῖν, of speaking without effect, not being understood, 1 Corinthiens 14:9.†

G0110.def:
ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ 
(ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Wis.3:4 4:1 8:13,17 15:3, 4Ma.14:5 16:13 * ;] 
immortality: 1 Corinthiens 15:53,54 1 Timothée 6:16 (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).†

G0111.def:
ἀ-θέμιτος (late form of ἀθέμιστος, LS, MM, VGT, see word), -ον 
(θέμις, custom, right), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:5 7:1 10:34, 3Ma.5:20 * ;] 
__(a) of persons, lawless (III Mac, l.with);
__(b) of things, lawless, unlawful: Actes 10:28, 1 Pierre 4:3.†
SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος.

G0112.def:
ἄ-θεος, -ον, 
__1. in cl. 
__(a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word); 
__(b) godless, ungodly (Pind.); 
__(with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.) 
__2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Éphésiens 2:12. 
†

G0113.def:
ἄθεσμος, -ον 
(θεσμός, law, custom), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:12 6:26 * ;] 
lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 2 Pierre 2:7 3:17.†
SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (see Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b).

G0114.def:
ἀθετέω, -ῶ (τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as 1 Rois 13:3 (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον , or do away with what has been laid down (see DCG, i, 453 f.)].
__1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , Galates 3:16; ἐντολήν , Marc 7:9; νόμον . Hébreux 10:28; πίστιν , 1 Timothée 5:12. 
__2. to nullify, make void: Luc 7:30 (see Field, Notes, 59), 1 Corinthiens 1:19, Galates 2:21.
__3. to reject: Marc 6:26 (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk 10:16, Jean 12:48, I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word). 
†

G0115.def:
ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ 
(ἀθετέω), [in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: 1 Rois 24:12 (פֶּשַׁע), Jérémie 12:1 (בֶּגֶד), Da TH 9:7 (מַעַל), 2Ma.14:28 * ;] 
a disannulling, setting aside: Hébreux 7:18 9:26 (for similar usage in π., see Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0116.def:
Ἀθῆναι, -ῶν, αἱ (plural because consisting of several parts), 
Athens: Actes 17:15,16 18:1, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:1.†

G0117.def: Athenian, of or from Athens , (Iliad by Homer), etc (ML)

G0118.def:
ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport), 
to contend in games, wrestle, combat: 2 Timothée 2:5.†

G0119.def:
ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ 
(ἀθλέω), 
a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; figuratively, a struggle: Hébreux 10:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0120.def:
ἀθυμέω, -ῶ (ἄ-θυμος, without heart), 
[in LXX for חרה, etc. ;] 
to be disheartened: Colossiens 3:21.†

G0121.def:
ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον 
(θωή, a penalty), [in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי ;] 
__1. unpunished (MM, VGT, see word). 
__2. innocent: Matthieu 27:4 (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24.

G0122.def:
αἴγειος (WH, -γιος), -α, -ον (αἶξ, a goat), 
[in LXX for עֵז ;] 
of a goat: Hébreux 11:37 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0123.def:
αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word), 
[in LXX: Juges 5:17 (חוֹף), Sir.24:14 * ;] 
the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Matthieu 13:2,48 Jean 21:4, Actes 21:5 27:39,40.†

G0125.def:
Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ, 
Egypt: Matthieu 2:13-15,19, Actes 2:10 7:9-39, Hébreux 3:16 11:26,27; γῆ Αἴ., Actes 7:40 13:17, Hébreux 8:9, Ju 5 (cf. Exode 5:12, al.); ἡ Αἴ., Actes 7:11; figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, Apocalypse 11:8.†

G0126.def:
ἀΐδιος, -ον 
(ἀεί), [in LXX: Wis.7:26, 4Ma.10:15 * ;] 
everlasting (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word): Romains 1:20, Ju 6.†
SYN.: αἰώνιος, also frequently in Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 363 J. The etymological distinction between the meanings of the two words seems not to be retained in late Greek (see Thayer, see word, αἰώνιος; cf. Cremer, 79, 611).

G0127.def:
αἰδώς (-όος), -οῦς, ἡ, 
[in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 4:5 * ;] 
a sense of shame, modesty: 1 Timothée 2:9 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: αἰσχύνη (see Thayer, 14; Tr., Syn., §xix; Cremer, 611 f.; CGT on I Ti, l.with).

G0128.def:
.*Αἰθίοψ, -οπος, ὁ 
(αἴθω, to burn, ὤψ, face; i.e. swarthy), [in LXX for כּוּשׁ ;] 
Ethiopian: Actes 8:27.†

G0129G.def:
αἷμα, ατος, τό, 
[in LXX for דָּם ;] 
blood. 
__1. In the ordinary sense: Marc 5:25, Luc 8:43,44 22:44, Jean 19:34, Actes 15:20,29 21:25, Apocalypse 8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13. 
__2. In special senses: 
__(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jean 1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word); 
__(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Matthieu 16:17, 1 Corinthiens 15:50, Galates 1:16, Éphésiens 6:12, Hébreux 2:14; 
__(with) of things in colour resembling blood: Actes 2:19,20, Apocalypse 6:12 14:18-20. 
__(d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): Matthieu 23:30,35 27:4,6,8,24,25, Luc 11:50,51 13:1, Actes 1:19 5:28 18:6 20:26 22:20, Hébreux 12:4, Apocalypse 6:10 17:6 18:24 19:2 ; αἷ. ἐκχέειν (Deiss., LAE, 428; MM, VGT, see word, αἷ.), Romains 3:15, Apocalypse 16:6; 
__(e) of sacrificial blood, as an expiation: Hébreux 9:7,12,13,18-22,25 10:4 11:28 13:11; of the blood of Christ, Matthieu 26:28, Marc 14:24, Luc 22:20, Jean 6:53,54,56, Actes 20:28, Romains 3:25 5:9, 1 Corinthiens 10:16 11:25,27, Éphésiens 1:7 2:13, Colossiens 1:20, Hébreux 9:12,14 10:19,29 12:24 13:20, 1 Pierre 1:2,19, 1 Jean 1:7 (cf. 5:6,8), Apocalypse 1:5 5:9 7:14 12:11. (Cremer, 69 f., 612 f.) 
†

G0129H.def:
αἷμα, ατος, τό, 
[in LXX for דָּם ;] 
blood. 
__1. In the ordinary sense: Marc 5:25, Luc 8:43,44 22:44, Jean 19:34, Actes 15:20,29 21:25, Apocalypse 8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13. 
__2. In special senses: 
__(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jean 1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word); 
__(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Matthieu 16:17, 1 Corinthiens 15:50, Galates 1:16, Éphésiens 6:12, Hébreux 2:14; 
__(with) of things in colour resembling blood: Actes 2:19,20, Apocalypse 6:12 14:18-20. 
__(d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): Matthieu 23:30,35 27:4,6,8,24,25, Luc 11:50,51 13:1, Actes 1:19 5:28 18:6 20:26 22:20, Hébreux 12:4, Apocalypse 6:10 17:6 18:24 19:2 ; αἷ. ἐκχέειν (Deiss., LAE, 428; MM, VGT, see word, αἷ.), Romains 3:15, Apocalypse 16:6; 
__(e) of sacrificial blood, as an expiation: Hébreux 9:7,12,13,18-22,25 10:4 11:28 13:11; of the blood of Christ, Matthieu 26:28, Marc 14:24, Luc 22:20, Jean 6:53,54,56, Actes 20:28, Romains 3:25 5:9, 1 Corinthiens 10:16 11:25,27, Éphésiens 1:7 2:13, Colossiens 1:20, Hébreux 9:12,14 10:19,29 12:24 13:20, 1 Pierre 1:2,19, 1 Jean 1:7 (cf. 5:6,8), Apocalypse 1:5 5:9 7:14 12:11. (Cremer, 69 f., 612 f.) 
†

G0130.def:
αἱματεκχυσία, -ας, ἡ 
(αἷμα, ἐκ, χέω), 
shedding of blood (Eccl.; Cremer, 71): Hébreux 9:22.†

G0131.def:
αἱμορροέω, 
(αἷμα, ῥέω), [in LXX: Lévitique 15:33 (דָּוֶה) * ;] 
to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): Matthieu 9:20.†

G0133.def:
αἴνεσις, -εως, ἡ 
(αἰνέω), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹדָה, תְּהִלָּה ;] 
praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως (Lévitique 7:12, זֶבַח תּוֹדָה), Hébreux 13:15.†

G0134.def:
αἰνέω, -ῶ (αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose (MM, VGT, see word) for cl. ἐπαινέω, 
[in LXX chiefly for הלל, ידה ;] 
to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, Luc 2:13,20 19:37 24:53, Actes 2:47 3:8,9, Romains 15:11; with dative, τ. Θεῷ (Jérémie 20:13, al. for הִלֵּל לְ; see Field, Notes, 245), Apocalypse 19:5.† 
SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω (see DCG, i, 211).

G0135.def:
αἴνιγμα, -ατος, τό 
(αἰνίσσομαι, to speak in riddles; αἰνός = δεινός, dread, strange), [in LXX for חִידָה, Nombres 12:8 and always exc. Deutéronome 28:37 (שַׁמָּה) ;] 
a dark saying, riddle: 1 Corinthiens 13:12 (cf. Nu, l.with).†

G0136.def:
αἶνος, ου, ὁ, 
[in LXX for הלל pi, עֹז ;] 
poët, and Ion., 
__1. = μῦθος, a tale (Horn., al.). 
__2. = Att. ἔπαινος, praise (Horn., al.): Matthieu 21:16 (LXX), Luc 18:43. 
__3. In π., a decree (MM, VGT, see word).
†

G0137.def:
Αἰνών, ἡ, indecl. (cf. Heb.עַיִן, a spring), 
Aenon: Jean 3:23.†

G0138.def:
αἱρέω, 
[in LXX for אמר hi., בּחר, etc. ;] 
to take; Mid., -ομαι (M, Pr., 158 f.; MM, VGT, see word), to choose: Philippiens 1:22, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:13, Hébreux 11:25. (Cf. ἀν-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐξ-, καθ-, περι-, προ-αιρέω.) †

G0139.def:
αἵρεσις, -εως, ἡ 
(αἱρέω, -ομαι), [in LXX for נְדָבָה,] 
__1. capture. 
__2. choosing, choice (see MM, VGT, see word). 
__3. that which is chosen, hence, opinion; esp. a peculiar opinion, heresy: 1 Corinthiens 11:19, Galates 5:20, 2 Pierre 2:1 R, txt. 
__4. In late writers (MM, VGT), of a set of persons professing particular principles or opinions, a school, sect, party, faction: Actes 5:17 15:5 24:5,14 26:5 28:22, I Co, Ga, II Pe, l.with, R, mg. (Cremer, 614).
†

G0140.def:
αἱρετίζω, 
[in LXX chiefly for בּחר (see Cremer, 615) ;] = αἱρέομαι (Hipp., Inscr.), 
to choose: Matthieu 12:18 (LXX, ἀντιλήμψομαι).†

G0141.def:
αἱρετικός, -ή, όν 
(αἱρέομαι), 
__1. capable of choosing (Plat.). 
__2. causing division, heretical, factious (Cremer, 614): as subst., Tite 3:10.
†

G0142.def:
αἴρω, 
[in LXX chiefly for נשׂא, also for לקח, etc. ;] 
__1. to raise, take up, lift or draw up: Jean 8:59 11:41, Actes 27:17, al. 
__2. to bear, carry: Matthieu 4:6 16:24, al. 
__3. to bear or take away, carry off, remove: Matthieu 21:21, Jean 19:31, 1 Corinthiens 5:12 6:15 (see Lft., Notes, 216), al.; of the taking away sin by Christ, Jean 1:29, 1 Jean 3:5. (Cf. ἀπ᾽, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, συν-, ὑπερ-αίρω). For exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word)

G0143.def:
αἰσθάνομαι, 
[in LXX for בּין, חפז, ידע ;] 
to perceive: withaccusative of thing(s) (Bl., §36, 5; MM, VGT, see word), Luc 9:45 (Cremer, 619 f.).†

G0144.def:
αἴσθησις, -εως, ἡ 
(αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת ;] 
perception (MM, VGT, see word): Philippiens 1:9.†
SYN.: ἐπίγνωσις, which see (cf. Cremer, 620).

G0145.def:
αἰσθητήριον, -ου, τό 
(αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX: Jérémie 4:19 (קִיר), 4Ma.2:22 * ;] 
sense, organ of perception: Hébreux 5:14 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0146.def:
αἰσχροκερδής, -ες 
(αἰσχρός, κέρδος), 
greedy of base gains: 1 Timothée 3:3,8 Abbot-Smith omits 1 Timothée 3:3, Tite 1:7.†

G0147.def:
αἰσχροκερδῶς, adv., 
from eagerness for base gain: 1 Pierre 5:2 (here only).†

G0148.def:
αἰσχρολογία, -ας, ἡ 
(αἰσχρός, λέγω), 
abusive language, abuse (Lft., ICC, in l.; MM, VGT, see word): Colossiens 3:8.†

G0150.def:
αἰσχρός, -ά, όν 
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: Genèse 41:3 ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;] 
base, shameful: 1 Corinthiens 11:6 14:35, Éphésiens 5:12, Tite 1:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0152.def:
αἰσχύνη, -ης, ἡ 
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX chiefly for בּשֶׁת ;] 
shame (MM, VGT, see word): subjectively, Luc 14:19, 2 Corinthiens 4:2; objectively, Philippiens 3:19, Hébreux 12:2; as something to be ashamed of, Apocalypse 3:18; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), shameful deeds, Ju 13.†
SYN.: αἰδώς, which see

G0153.def:
αἰσχύνω 
(αἶσχος, shame), [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;] 
__1. to disfigure (Hom.). 
__2. to dishonour (Proverbes 29:15). 
__3. to make ashamed (Sir.13:7). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: 2 Corinthiens 10:8; Philippiens 1:20, 1 Pierre 4:16, 1 Jean 2:28; with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luc 16:3 (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω). 
†

G0154.def:
αἰτέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁאל ;] 
to ask, request: absol., Matthieu 7:7, Jacques 1:6; with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 5:42, Luc 6:30; with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Matthieu 20:20, 1 Jean 5:15; id. before παρά, Actes 3:2, Jacques 1:5; with dupl. accusative Matthieu 7:9, Marc 6:22, Jean 16:23. Mid. (on the distinction bet. mid. and act., see M, Pr., 160): absol., Marc 15:8, Jean 16:26, Jacques 4:3; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 14:7, Marc 6:24, al.; with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 27:20, Luc 23:25; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, Actes 9:2; with accusative and inf., Luc 23:23. with inf. Actes 7:46, Éphésiens 3:13 (cf. ἀπ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, παρ-, προσ- αιτέω).
SYN.: ἐρωτάω, which see, πυνθάνομαι. On the proper distinction between these words, see Tr., Syn., § xl, Thayer, see word αἰ. In late Gk., however, αἰ. and ἐ. seem to have become practically synonymous (cf. Actes 3:2,3; see Field, Notes, 101 f.; M, Th., I, 4:1; M, Pr., 66.n; MM, VGT, see word).

G0155.def:
αἴτημα, -ατος, τό 
(αἰτέω), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁאֵלָה ;] 
that which has been asked for, a petition, request: Luc 23:24, Philippiens 4:6, Jean 5:15.†
SYN.: see: δέησις.

G0156.def:
αἰτία, -ας, ἡ, 
[in LXX: Genèse 4:13 (עָוֹן), Proverbes 28:17 (עָשַׁק), and frequently in Wi, II, III Mac ;] 
__1. cause, reason, occasion, case: Matthieu 19:3, Luc 8:47, Actes 10:21 22:24 28:20, 2 Timothée 1:6,12, Tite 1:13, Hébreux 2:11 ; εἰ οὕτως ἐστιν ἡ αἰ. (cf. Lat. si ita res se habet, and see MM. VGT, see word), Matthieu 19:10. 
__2. In forensic sense, 
__(a) accusation: Actes 25:18,27; 
__(b) cause for punishment, crime: Matthieu 27:37, Marc 15:26, Jean 18:38 19:4,6, Actes 13:28 23:28 28:18.
† SYN.: ἔλεγχος, a charge, whether moral or judicial, which has been proven, αἰ. is an accusation simply, false or true.

G0157.def:
αἰτίωμα (Rec. αἰτίαμα, the usual form; see MM, VGT, see word), -τος, τό 
(αἰτιάομαι, αἰτία), 
a charge, accusation: Actes 25:7.†

G0159.def:
αἴτιος, -α, ὁ 
(αἰτία), [in LXX: 1 Rois 22:22 (סבב) Dan LXX Bel 41, TH ib. 42, Su 53, 2Ma.4:47 13:4, 4Ma.1:11 * ;] 
__1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: Hébreux 5:9; τὸ αἰ., the cause, Actes 19:40. 
__2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, Luc 23:4,14,22. 
†

G0160.def:
αἰφνίδιος (in Lk, l.with, ἐφν- WH; see M, Pr., 35), -ον 
(αἴφνης = ἄφνως, suddenly), [in LXX: Wis.17:15, 2Ma.14:17, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] 
sudden, unexpected: Luc 21:34, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:3.†

G0161.def:
αἰχμαλωσία -ας, ἡ 
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִי, גּוֹלָה ;] 
captivity (Diod., al.): Apocalypse 13:10; pl., abstr. for concr., = αἰχμάλωτοι, Éphésiens 4:8 (LXX).†

G0162.def:
αἰχμαλωτεύω 
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] = αἰχμαλωτίζω, which see, 
to lead captive: Éphésiens 4:8 (LXX).†

G0163.def:
αἰχμαλωτίζω 
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] in late writers = cl. αἰχμάλωτον ποιῶ (ἄγω), 
to take or lead captive: before εἰς, Luc 21:24 (cf. Tob.1:10); metaphorically, Romains 7:23, 2 Corinthiens 10:5, 2 Timothée 3:6.†

G0164.def:
αἰχμάλωτος, -ον 
(αἰχμή, a spear, ἁλίσκομαι, to be taken), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁבָה, גּוֹלָה ;] 
captive: Luc 4:18 (LXX).†

G0165G.def:
αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;] 
__1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); 
__(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luc 1:70; 
__(b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Matthieu 21:19; id., with neg., never, Jean 4:14; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., Hébreux 1:8 (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., Matthieu 6:13; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. Ésaïe 45:17, עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), Romains 16:27, LT; cf. also Éphésiens 3:21, 2 Pierre 3:18, Ju 25, Apocalypse 14:11. 
__2. οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He :12 11:3 (cf. 1 Timothée 1:17, where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity". 
__3. the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., Matthieu 13:22; ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, Matthieu 12:32; ὁ νῦν αἰ., 1 Timothée 6:17; ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., Galates 1:4; similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, Luc 20:35; ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, Matthieu 12:32; ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, Marc 10:30.
SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on Hébreux 1:2; Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT).

G0165H.def:
αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;] 
__1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); 
__(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luc 1:70; 
__(b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Matthieu 21:19; id., with neg., never, Jean 4:14; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., Hébreux 1:8 (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., Matthieu 6:13; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. Ésaïe 45:17, עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), Romains 16:27, LT; cf. also Éphésiens 3:21, 2 Pierre 3:18, Ju 25, Apocalypse 14:11. 
__2. οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He :12 11:3 (cf. 1 Timothée 1:17, where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity". 
__3. the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., Matthieu 13:22; ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, Matthieu 12:32; ὁ νῦν αἰ., 1 Timothée 6:17; ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., Galates 1:4; similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, Luc 20:35; ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, Matthieu 12:32; ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, Marc 10:30.
SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on Hébreux 1:2; Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT).

G0167.def:
ἀκαθαρσία, -ας, ἡ 
(ἀκάθαρτος), [in LXX chiefly for טֻמְאָה, טָמֵא ;] 
uncleanness, impurity, 
__(a) physical (MM, VGT, see word): Matthieu 23:27;
__(b) moral: Romains 1:24 6:19, 2 Corinthiens 12:21, Galates 5:19, Éphésiens 4:19 5:3, Colossiens 3:5, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:3 4:7. 
†

G0170.def:
ἀκαιρέομαι, -οῦμαι 
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), 
to have no opportunity (opposite to εὐκαιρέω): Philippiens 4:10.†

G0171.def:
ἀκαίρως, adv. 
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;] 
out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2 Timothée 4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0172.def:
ἄκακος, -ον, 
[in LXX for פְּתִי, תָּם, etc. ;] 
__(a) as in cl. (Æsch., Plat., al.), of persons, simple, guileless: Romains 16:18, Hébreux 7:26 (cf. Cremer, 327); 
__(b) of things, undamaged (? MM, VGT, see word). 
†

G0173.def:
ἄκανθα, -ης, ἡ 
(ἀκή, a point), [in LXX chiefly for קוֹץ, also for סִיר, שַׁיִת, etc. ;] 
a prickly plant, thorn, brier; in NT always pl.: Matthieu 7:16 13:7,22 27:29, Marc 4:7,18, Luc 6:44 8:7,14, Jean 19:2, Hébreux 6:8 (see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0174.def:
ἀκάνθινος, -ον 
(ἄκανθα), [in LXX: Ésaïe 34:13 (סיר) * ;] 
__1. of thorns: Marc 15:17, Jean 19:5.
__2. of acantha-wood (Hdt.; π. ap. MM, VGT, see word). 
†

G0175.def:
ἄ-καρπος, -ον, 
[in LXX: Jérémie 2:6 (צַלְמָוֶת), Wis.15:4, 4Ma.16:7 ;] 
unfruitful, barren: figuratively, Matthieu 13:22, Marc 4:19, 1 Corinthiens 14:14, Éphésiens 5:11, Tite 3:14, 2 Pierre 1:8, Ju 12.†

G0176.def:
ἀ-κατά-γνωστος, -ον 
(καταγινώσκω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:47 ;] 
not open to just rebuke, irreprehensible: Tite 2:8 (see Cremer, 676; and for other exx., MM, VGT, see word).†

G0177.def:
ἀ-κατα-κάλυπτος, -ον 
(κατακαλύπτω), [in LXX: Lévitique 13:45 A (פָּרוּע) * ;] 
uncovered, unveiled: 1 Corinthiens 11:5, 13.†

G0178.def:
ἀ-κατά-κριτος, -ον 
(κατακρίνω), 
__1. uncondemned (EV): Actes 16:37, 22:25.
__2. = cl. ἄκριτος, without trial, not yet tried (MM, VGT, see word) Ac, ll. cc. 
†

G0180.def:
ἀκατάπαυστος, -ον 
(καταπαύω), 
that cannot cease, not to be restrained: with genitive of thing(s), 2 Pierre 2:14, T, Tr. txt.†

G0181.def:
ἀκαταστασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκατάστατος), 
[in LXX: Proverbes 26:28 (מִדְחֶה), Tob.4:13 * ;] 
instability (MM, VGT, see word); hence, confusion, tumult: 1 Corinthiens 14:33, Jacques 3:16; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), Luc 21:9, 2 Corinthiens 6:5, 12:20 (Polyb., al.; see Cremer, 739).†

G0182.def:
ἀ-κατά-στατος, -ον (καθίστημι), 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 54:11 (סֹעֲרָה) ;] 
unsettled, unstable: Jacques 1:8, 3:8.†

G0184.def: § Akeldama dama (Proper name) (traditionally located south of the valley of Hinnom), "field of blood"

G0185.def:
ἀκέραιος, -ον 
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: Esther 8:13 * ;] 
unmixed, pure, hence, metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), guileless, simple: Matthieu 10:16, Romains 16:19, Philippiens 2:15.†
SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς (cf. Ellic. on Phl., l.with; Tr., Syn., §lvi).

G0186.def:
ἀκλινής, -ές (κλίνω), 
[in LXX: 4Ma.6:7 17:3 * ;] 
unbending, firm: metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word). Hébreux 10:23.†

G0187.def:
ἀκμάζω 
(ἀκμήν), [in LXX: 4Ma.2:3 * ;] 
to be at the prime; of produce of the ground, to be ripe (Thuc.): Apocalypse 14:18 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0188.def:
ἀκμήν, accusative of ἀκμή, 
a point, used as adv., at the present point of time, even now, even yet: Matthieu 15:16.†

G0189.def:
ἀκοή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(ἀκούω), [in LXX: Exode 15:26, al. for שׁמע, its parts and derivatives, exc. Deutéronome 11:22 (שׁמר) ;] 
__1. hearing, the sense of hearing: 1 Corinthiens 12:17, 2 Pierre 2:8; "Hebraic dative," ἀκοῇ ακούειν (frequently in LXX; V. M, Pr., 14, 75), Matthieu 13:14, Actes 28:26.
__2. organ of hearing, the ear (Arist., al.; MM, VGT, see word): 2 Timothée 4:3-4; pl., Marc 7:35, Luc 7:1, Actes 17:20, Hébreux 5:11.
__3. a thing heard, i.e., 
__(a) a message, teaching: Jean 12:38 and Romains 16:16,17" (LXX), Galates 3:2,5 R, mg.; λόγος ἀκοῆς, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:13, Hébreux 4:2;
__(b) a report, rumour: with genitive, of person(s), Matthieu 4:24, 14:1, 24:6; Marc 1:28 13:7 (Cremer, 82, 623; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0190.def:
ἀκολουθέω, -ῶ 
(ἀκόλουθος, following; ἀ- cop., κέλευθος, poët., away), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;] 
to accompany, follow: Matthieu 4:25, al. Metaphorical, of discipleship: Matthieu 9:9, Marc 9:38, Jean 12:26, al. Absol.: Matthieu 18:10; more freq., with dative (cl.), Matthieu 8:1, al.; before μετά, with genitive, (cl.; Eutherford, N.Phr., 458 f.), Luc 9:49; ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אָהֲרֵי), Matthieu 10:38 (cf. ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-, συν-ἀκολουθέω).
SYN.: (cl.) ἕπομαι, not in NT (see Cremer, 80; MM, VGT, see word).

G0191.def:
ἀκούω, 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁמע ] 
to hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing. 
__1. Intrans.: Marc 4:3 7:37, Jacques 2:5, Apocalypse 2:7, al.; τ. ὠσίν, Matthieu 13:15 (LXX); with cogn. dative, ακοῇ ἀ. (see: ἀκοή), Matthieu 13:14, Actes 28:26" (LXX) ; ὁ ἔχων ὦτα (οὖς) ἀκούειν, ἀκουσάτω, Matthieu 11:15, Marc 4:23, Apocalypse 2:7, al. 
__2. Trans., prop. with accusative of thing(s), of thing heard, genitive of person(s), from whom heard (LS, see word): Actes 1:4; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 12:19, Jean 3:8 (Abbott, JG, 76), Actes 22:9, al.; with dupl. accusative, Jean 12:18, 1 Corinthiens 11:18; with genitive of thing(s), Jean 7:40 (Abbott, JV, 116); τ. φωνῆς (cf. Heb. שָׁמַע בְּקוֹל, Exode 18:19), Jean 5:25, 28 Actes 9:7 (on the distinction bet. this and ἀ. φωνήν, ib. 4, see M, Pr., 66; Field, Notes, 117; Abbott, Essays, 93f.); of God answering prayer, Jean 9:31, 1 Jean 5:14, 15; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, Jean 8:26, 40 Actes 10:22, 2 Timothée 2:2; id. before ἀπό, 1 Jean 1:5; with genitive pars. before ptcp., Marc 14:58, Luc 18:36, al. (On NT usage generally, see Bl., §36, 5; Cremer, 82.)

G0192.def:
ἀκρασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀκρατής, which see), [in LXX: 1Ma.6:26 * ;] 
in Arist. and later writers = ἀκράτεια (Lft., Notes, 222 f.), want of power, hence want of self-control, incontinence: Matthieu 23:25, 1 Corinthiens 7:5.†

G0193.def:
ἀκρατής, -ές
(κράτος), [in LXX: Proverbes 27:20 * ;] 
__(a) powerless, impotent; 
__(b) in moral sense, lacking self-control, incontinent: 2 Timothée 3:3.†

G0194.def:
ἄκρατος, -ον
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: Psaumes 75:8 (חֲמַר), Jérémie 25:15 (חֵמָה), 3Ma.5:2 * ;] 
unmixed, pure: οἶνος, Apocalypse 14:10.†

G0195.def:
ἀκρίβεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH 7:16 (יַצִּיב), Wis.12:21, Sir.16:25 42:4 * ;] 
exactness, precision (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word): Actes 22:3.†

G0196.def:
ἀκριβής, -ές 
[in LXX: Dan LXX 2:45 6:12 (יַצִּיב) Daniel 4:25, Esther 4:5, Sir.18:29 19:25 31:24 32:3 * ;] 
exact, precise, careful, of things and persons: superl., Actes 26:5.†

G0197.def:
ἀκριβῶς 
adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deutéronome 19:18 (יָטַב), Da TH 7:19 (יְצֵב), Eze.39:14, Wis.19:18, Sir.18:29 ;] 
with exactness, carefully: Matthieu 2:8, Luc 1:3, Actes 18:25, Éphésiens 5:15, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Actes 18:26 23:15, 20 24:22.†

G0198.def:
ἀκριβόω, -ῶ
(ἀκριβής), [in Aq.: Ésaïe 30:8 49:16 * ;] 
to enquire with exactness, learn carefully: Matthieu 2:7, 16 (for similar ex., see MM, VGT, sv.).†

G0199.def:
ἀκριβῶς 
adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deutéronome 19:18 (יָטַב), Da TH 7:19 (יְצֵב), Eze.39:14, Wis.19:18, Sir.18:29 ;] 
with exactness, carefully: Matthieu 2:8, Luc 1:3, Actes 18:25, Éphésiens 5:15, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Actes 18:26 23:15, 20 24:22.†
